m10.text: Shandalar is the plane where the demon Kothophed sends Liliana to find the Chain Veil.
Enhanced by the veil, Liliana dispatches Garruk in the Onakke temple.

m11.text: In Magic 2011, Shandalar is where Garruk's spark ignites and he planeswalks for the first time.
He hunts the Ursoth, then rages at Liliana for killing one of his beasts and assaults her in an Onakke temple, but Liliana uses the Chain Veil to overpower and curse him.
